label: 📺뉴스
message:
/setvar key="news_instruction" Pause the story. Generate 3 news articles.

[WRITING RULES]
1. Write 3 internet news articles that match the era and current situation of the world-building.
2. Referencing the ongoing scenario, ensure at least one article covers an event involving NPC or {{user}}.
3. Each article must include a Title, Summary, body, Date, Author, and Comments.
4. The body of each article should be approximately 300 to 400 characters long.
5. The content can vary from serious incidents to new announcements or trivial/cute news. Ensure they align with the scenario.
6. Each article must be followed by 3 comments.

[CRITICAL FORMATTING RULES: Display the date as month and day only, without the year. For the reporter's name, display only the name itself. All comments must unconditionally start with "cmtnick: ".]

**Precisely follow the <halonews> tag format for EACH article.**

[Format per article]
<halonews>
title: [Title] | summary: [Summary] | body: [Main Body] | date: [MM-DD] | author: [Reporter Name] | cmtnick: [Nickname] | cmt: [Comment] | cmtnick: [Nickname] | cmt: [Comment] | cmtnick: [Nickname] | cmt: [Comment]
</halonews>
|
/gen {{getvar::news_instruction}}
|
/sendas name="{{groupNotMuted}}"
|
/flushvar news_instruction
